solution.summary: In this paper, we propose a novel voxel-based architecture, namely Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT), to detect 3D objects from point clouds by means of set-to-set translation. To address the above issues, we introduce a voxel-based set attention (VSA) module.
solution.approach: In this paper, we propose a novel voxel-based architecture, namely Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT), to detect 3D objects from point clouds by means of set-to-set translation.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel voxel-based architecture, namely Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT), to detect 3D objects from point clouds by means of set-to-set translation.
To address the above issues, we introduce a voxel-based set attention (VSA) module.
With VSA, we propose a Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT) to detect 3D objects by learning point cloud features in a set-to-set translation process.

experiments.summary: Each token has to be updated by using all the other tokens from previous layers, making self-attention intractable for long sequence point clouds. This results in unstable detection results and redundant computations.

items: The main limitation of transformer models, however, lies in that the selfattention computation is quadratic.

In summary, in this work we first invent a voxel-based set attention module, which can model long-range dependencies from the token cluster of arbitrary size, bypassing the limitation of current grouped-based and convolution-based attention modules.
